mission.outcome: Land HMS Onslaught M21: extend M20 Stefan v2 with a distributed side-heat source term S(x,t) representing heat conducted in from tin sidewalls. 6-param fit (M20's 5 + new Q_side magnitude). Single-fixture decision gate on BA3C_0946 with bar main-bake RMSE less than 4 C and at least 4/6 params interior. Tests the 1D-vs-effective-2D assumption shared by all 18 prior inverse-problem missions.
